headline.title: Building trust in the AI era with privacy-led UX
headline.summary: The article discusses the concept of privacy-led user experience (UX), emphasizing the importance of transparency in data collection and usage as a key element of customer relationships. It highlights the potential of this approach in digital marketing, viewing user consent as a foundational step rather than a mere compliance requirement.

articles.title: Anthropic’s rise is giving some OpenAI investors second thoughts
articles.summary: Investors are reconsidering their support for OpenAI as Anthropic's valuation of $380 billion appears more attractive compared to OpenAI's recent funding round, which implies a potential IPO valuation of $1.2 trillion or higher. This shift in perspective highlights growing competition and valuation concerns within the AI sector.

articles.title: Turn your best AI prompts into one-click tools in Chrome
articles.summary: A new feature in Chrome allows users to convert their best AI prompts into one-click tools, streamlining access and usage. This functionality aims to enhance productivity by simplifying the process of utilizing AI capabilities directly within the browser.

articles.title: Modality-Native Routing in Agent-to-Agent Networks: A Multimodal A2A Protocol Extension
articles.summary: A recent study demonstrates that modality-native routing in Agent-to-Agent (A2A) networks enhances task accuracy by 20 percentage points compared to text-bottleneck baselines, provided that the downstream reasoning agent can utilize the preserved context. The findings suggest that preserving multimodal signals is crucial for effective cross-modal reasoning in AI systems.

articles.title: DeepTest Tool Competition 2026: Benchmarking an LLM-Based Automotive Assistant
articles.summary: The first edition of the Large Language Model Testing competition, part of the DeepTest workshop at ICSE 2026, focused on benchmarking an LLM-based automotive assistant designed for car manual information retrieval. Four tools participated in the competition, which aimed to identify user inputs that led to the omission of important warnings from the manual.

articles.title: The Second Challenge on Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection at NTIRE 2026: Methods and Results
articles.summary: The second Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection (CD-FSOD) Challenge was held at NTIRE 2026 to assess advancements in detecting objects across different domains with minimal annotations. The event attracted significant participation from the research community, highlighting ongoing challenges in the field.

articles.title: Fully Homomorphic Encryption on Llama 3 model for privacy preserving LLM inference
articles.summary: The article discusses the implementation of Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) on the Llama 3 model to enhance privacy during large language model (LLM) inference. It highlights the growing concerns over data security in generative AI applications across various sectors, including healthcare and finance.

articles.title: Nemotron 3 Super: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
articles.summary: The Nemotron 3 Super is a 120 billion parameter hybrid Mamba-Attention Mixture-of-Experts model designed for efficient agentic reasoning, featuring innovations such as pre-training in NVFP4 and the LatentMoE architecture. This model aims to optimize accuracy per FLOP and parameter, and includes MTP layers to enhance inference speed.

articles.title: Lit2Vec: A Reproducible Workflow for Building a Legally Screened Chemistry Corpus from S2ORC for Downstream Retrieval and Text Mining
articles.summary: The article introduces Lit2Vec, a reproducible workflow designed for creating a legally screened chemistry corpus from the Semantic Scholar Open Research Corpus. This workflow resulted in a study corpus of 582,683 full-text chemistry research articles, complete with structured text and paragraph-level embeddings for enhanced retrieval and text mining.

articles.title: NTIRE 2026 The 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) Challenge: Professional Image Quality Assessment (Track 1)
articles.summary: The NTIRE 2026 challenge introduces the 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) focusing on Professional Image Quality Assessment in Track 1. This initiative aims to address the limitations of conventional Image Quality Assessment methods, which often oversimplify complex visual characteristics into a single scalar score.

articles.title: KumoRFM-2: Scaling Foundation Models for Relational Learning
articles.summary: KumoRFM-2 is a newly introduced pre-trained foundation model designed specifically for relational data, enabling in-context learning and fine-tuning for various predictive tasks. Unlike traditional tabular models, KumoRFM-2 can process multiple connected tables simultaneously without the need for manual table flattening or target variable generation.

articles.title: DoseRAD2026 Challenge dataset: AI accelerated photon and proton dose calculation for radiotherapy
articles.summary: The DoseRAD2026 Challenge dataset offers a public benchmark of paired CT and MRI data, along with beam-level photon and proton Monte Carlo dose distributions, aimed at enhancing the accuracy and speed of dose calculations in radiotherapy. This initiative addresses the increasing demand for precise tumor irradiation while minimizing damage to healthy tissue, particularly in the context of MRI-guided and real-time adaptive radiotherapy.
